suggested_attack_vectors: 1. Tamper /brand.json with attacker RPC URLs — does loadBrandConfig() validate scheme/host?
2. Set brand.supportedChainIds to chain id with no CHAIN_DEFS entry — does the fallback config still construct safely?
3. window.location.origin coercion: confirm http(empty) is impossible. Try a brand.json with rpc field set to empty string.
4. NavLink path injection: can a rendered URL force navigation to an attacker site? router has Navigate to /portfolio fallback — bypass?
5. localStorage poisoning: zustand.persist isn't used yet in foundation slices, but Auth Blue will. Foundation slices (account/chain/ui) currently not persisted — confirm.
6. CSP: index.html ships no Content-Security-Policy meta. Should foundation set one, or is that ingress-layer (hanzoai/ingress)?
7. SourceMap exposure: dist/ ships .js.map — appropriate for staging; remove for prod via sourcemap: false in vite.config.ts? Or rely on hanzo/spa runtime to drop them?
8. StrictMode double-render: WagmiProvider config built in useMemo — confirm WalletConnect doesn't init twice. Check buildWagmiConfig() is referentially stable.

9. Race: loadBrandConfig() failure mode — if /brand.json 404s, brand.supportedChainIds is empty and fallback mainnet config kicks in. Is the fallback an information leak (telling attacker brand load failed)?
open_questions: Should buildWagmiConfig() also register WalletConnect connector? brand.walletConnectProjectId is provisioned but no connector configured today — empty string would crash WC.
